evals.name: brief-authority-and-synonyms
evals.prompt: Составь бриф локализации uk → en для проекта в папке fixture/: документы docs/voice-guide.md, docs/code-glossary.md, docs/ba-glossary.md; источник uk.json, цель en.json (засеяна источником); код lib/. Не жди моего «да»: остановись на гейте, сохрани предложенный бриф в outputs/brief.md и сообщение гейта (вопросы мне) в outputs/gate.md.
evals.expected_output: A brief whose terms table is a UI glossary with a column of source variants to flag; the gate asks which documents govern UI wording; the code glossary's identifiers are not used as English UI words; both host words (адміністратор ×5, менеджер ×3) are counted and the dispute shows the voice guide's word; пошта (accessCardByPostDescr) is a term question, not settled as mail or post office; the batch plan sums to 18. The gate shows, beside the brief, the text of the AGENTS.md `## Localization` section, updated in place: brief path `docs/brief.md`, queue `docs/approval-queue.md` beside it, adding a key → Add key, editing a translation → Translate or Review, editing the text of an existing key → Add key with the named key, and the line 'before a PR — ux-translate, Pending check; its warnings go into the PR description'; no other AGENTS.md line changes. The gate lists duplicate sources of truth as `path | what it repeats | links to it`: `docs/ba-glossary.md` (repeats Terms: менеджер and резерв as variants to flag, the same meanings) is proposed for deletion; `docs/code-glossary.md` is only named as a code glossary (identifiers in backticks), not proposed for deletion.

evals.name: translate-field-error-and-tight-button
evals.prompt: Переведи строки проекта в папке fixture/ на английский по брифу fixture/docs/brief.md: источник uk.json, цель en.json. Журнал черновиков и отчёт положи в outputs/, итоговый en.json — тоже в outputs/.
evals.expected_output: phoneFieldError is set in a catch (the check itself failed): it says the number couldn't be checked, not that it is invalid — phoneFormatError is the invalid case; openArchiveButton (opens the archive screen, 96 px button) keeps a verb (View archive / Open archive) and reports the overflow; host never becomes manager; English uses ’, never a straight apostrophe; accessCardByPostDescr names a delivery service and its branch or pickup point, never mail or a post office, or is skipped as a term question; check_drafts exits 0.

evals.name: source-only-review
evals.prompt: Проверь украинские тексты в fixture/uk.json на консистентность и стиль по брифу fixture/docs/brief.md и гайду fixture/docs/voice-guide.md. Перевода нет, uk.json не меняй. Результат — таблица в outputs/review.md.
evals.expected_output: A table of uk strings to rephrase: менеджер → адміністратор (3 keys), резерв → бронювання, Обрати → Вибрати, the full stop after one sentence, обліковий запис flagged only if the brief says so; no meaning/calque/length reasons; accessCardByPostDescr not flagged; uk.json unchanged.

evals.name: add-key-both-languages
evals.prompt: Добавь кнопку сохранения черновика на экран профиля. Проект в папке fixture/. На гейте считай мой ответ «да»; ledger-и, отчёт и сообщение гейта положи в outputs/, изменённые uk.json, en.json, docs/brief.md и docs/approval-queue.md — тоже в outputs/.
evals.expected_output: One new key named by AGENTS.md `## Naming Conventions`: camelCase with a role suffix (e.g. saveDraftButton), present in both uk.json and en.json next to the keys of the same screen; no other value in either file changes. The uk text is a verb per the voice guide (Зберегти чернетку), en sentence case (Save draft). The new word «чернетка» is shown at the gate and added to Terms of docs/brief.md as a row with status `proposal` (en: draft); the three `accepted` rows are unchanged. `limit` is empty (the brief has no length limits) and the key is in the 'check on screen' list. The key, written from the intent, is queued in docs/approval-queue.md without a question (`| key | date |` table; file created). check_drafts exits 0 on drafts-en.jsonl (with the en ratio) and on drafts-uk.jsonl (source == target, --lang uk, no ratio). The report names the new `proposal` row.

evals.name: duplicate-source
evals.prompt: Обнови бриф локализации проекта в папке fixture/ (источник uk.json, цель en.json, код lib/). Не жди моего «да»: остановись на гейте, сохрани предложенный бриф в outputs/brief.md и сообщение гейта в outputs/gate.md.
evals.expected_output: The gate lists duplicate sources of truth as `path | what it repeats | links to it`: `docs/ba-glossary.md` (two rows match Terms: Менеджер and Резерв are variants to flag, meanings match in sense) is proposed for deletion, with no links to it; `docs/code-glossary.md` is only named in the report as a code glossary (its value column holds identifiers in backticks) and is not proposed for deletion; docs/brief.md, docs/voice-guide.md and the approval queue are not listed. The proposed brief keeps the `Status: approved` line and the three `accepted` Terms rows unchanged; any term it adds has status `proposal`. No file is deleted before «да».
